messages:
Sam (eng): Quick heads-up: all-hands starts in 10. Tiny agenda change: skip extended demo Q&A until after leadership brief. Also need final AV checks.
Eli (infra): Caption workers had a small backlog but cleared. Restarted the caption collector at 09:02. :ok_hand:
Marta (comms): Can we get a speaker order? I need to tag people for the recording notes.
Ravi (design): I'll post the updated slide link in 2. Removed the animated transitions to speed up the flow.
Jaya (prod): Leadership wants an extra 5m Q&A at the end for roadmap clarifications. Reduce demo time by 5.
Sam (eng): Noted. @Ravi upload and ping. If captions fail, fallback is local audio + manual timestamping.
Marta (comms): Question: do we prefer follow-up Qs in the GDoc or Slack?
Jaya (prod): Use the GDoc for formal questions, Slack thread for live quick ones. I'll triage.
allhands-bot: Recording scheduled to start in 3 minutes. Join link: https://zoom.company/all-hands
Eli (infra): If OBS drops, run:
```
pkill -f obs || true
sleep 2
obs --startrecording --minimize-to-tray &
```
That should bring the virtual cam back. Tested on staging.
Sam (eng): Please mute when not speaking. Watch captions at :45s — that's where we saw stutters earlier. @Eli can you monitor?
Eli (infra): On it. Tail command if needed: `tail -n 200 /var/log/captions/*.log | grep ERROR`
Ravi (design): Uploaded: drive.company/allhands/roadmap_final.pptx :rocket:
Marta (comms): I'll schedule the recording post and set transcript retention to 48h.
Jaya (prod): Leaders will clarify Dedicated GA timeline in two bullets during roadmap.
Sam (eng): Note: OBS restart causes a 10-20s gap; we'll stitch the video later.
Eli (infra): Monitoring live. I
Marta (comms): Posting speaker list now.
Sam (eng): Thanks team. See you in 7.
